corpus/upstream/opentitan/hw/ip/prim/rtl/prim_count.sv:7:// This internally uses a cross counter scheme with primary and a secondary counter, where the

corpus/upstream/opentitan/hw/ip/prim/rtl/prim_count.sv:12://
corpus/upstream/opentitan/hw/ip/prim/rtl/prim_count.sv:13:// clr_i: This clears the primary counter to ResetValue and adjusts the secondary counter to match

corpus/upstream/opentitan/hw/ip/prim/rtl/prim_count.sv:16://        (i.e. 2**Width-1-set_cnt_i). Set has priority over increment and decrement.
corpus/upstream/opentitan/hw/ip/prim/rtl/prim_count.sv:17:// incr_en_i: Increments the primary counter by step_i, and decrements the secondary by step_i.
corpus/upstream/opentitan/hw/ip/prim/rtl/prim_count.sv:18:// decr_en_i: Decrements the primary counter by step_i, and increments the secondary by step_i.
corpus/upstream/opentitan/hw/ip/prim/rtl/prim_count.sv:19:// commit_i: Counter changes only take effect when `commit_i` is set. This does not effect the
corpus/upstream/opentitan/hw/ip/prim/rtl/prim_count.sv:20://           `cnt_after_commit_o` output which gives the next counter state if the change is
corpus/upstream/opentitan/hw/ip/prim/rtl/prim_count.sv:21://           committed.
corpus/upstream/opentitan/hw/ip/prim/rtl/prim_count.sv:22://
